item: GET /api/wiki/lane/status reads the lane at most once per 30 s window and says how old the answer is
summary: The Home strip's poll ran three full scans of the lane per call (1.56 M change rows): 528 calls in the 10-16 zips at p50 2.0 s / p95 6.2 s / max 30.5 s while the other local polls ran 0.03-0.07 s. A measured answer is now served again for 30 s with cached/age_s on it, a new local day or any failure/absent/unreadable lane reads again, and concurrent polls share one read.
